title: The week in motion
description: Straight segments preserve numeric intervals; displaced endpoint labels keep series readable.

props.name: data
props.description: Caller-owned { id, label, x, values } observations with finite, strictly increasing numeric X. Values are keyed by series ID and may be signed; missing readings break each series. Unique, nonempty observation IDs are required. Endpoint labels and key values refer to the final supplied observation, including unavailable readings.

props.name: series
props.description: Ordered { id, label, tone? } series with unique, nonempty IDs. Explicit tones a–d or stable identity determine category color. Reordering preserves color. Endpoint names truncate with an ellipsis to fit their gutter; the key and inspection retain full labels.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Caller-owned heading and measurement unit. Defaults to Value (Total for NocturneRing).

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: Optional caller-owned time window or reporting context.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats exact readings and tooltips; defaults to en-US with at most two decimals. Compact plot annotations retain the full value in inspection.

props.name: width
props.description: Total width in pixels; otherwise fills the container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels. Dense plots and keys scroll inside the frame.

props.name: animate
props.description: Finite native drawing using scoped motion tokens and live reduced-motion preference; defaults to true.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible title for the native chart.
